from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Paper(BaseModel):
    """One provided paper: its title and which other provided papers it references."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The paper's title")
    references: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of other provided papers that appear in this paper's reference list")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    papers: list[Paper]
